  …goreleaser, which builds the binaries for darwin/arm64 …│ kompass  claude
                                                           │ 2026-10-31 22:35
                                                           │────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                                                           │ ---
                                                           │ name: release-process
                                                           │ description: How a kompass release is cut and published
                                                           │ metadata:
                                                           │   type: project
                                                           │ ---
                                                           │
                                                           │ A release is a signed tag on main. The release workflow
                                                           │ then runs goreleaser, which builds the binaries for
                                                           │ darwin/arm64 and linux/amd64 and publishes the Homebrew
                                                           │ cask to the tap.
                                                           │
                                                           │ Steps
                                                           │
                                                           │ 1. Update the changelog under the next version.
                                                           │ 2. Tag with git tag -s vX.Y.Z and push the tag.
                                                           │ 3. Wait for the workflow; the cask lands in mara/homebrew-
                                                           │ tap.
                                                           │
                                                           │ Why: a missing HOMEBREW_TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN used to leave a
                                                           │ half-published release. The workflow now fails early.
                                                           │
                                                           │ How to apply: never publish the cask by hand; if the
                                                           │ workflow fails, fix the cause and re-run it.
                                                           │
